report.summary: Payment-service experienced a 4x increase in p95 latency during the investigation window, accompanied by errors indicating fraud-check dependency failures.

likely_causes.title: Fraud-api timeout causing payment-service latency
likely_causes.rationale: Timeouts in the fraud-api dependency caused payment-service to wait longer for responses, leading to increased latency and request failures.

supporting_evidence.detail: WARN payment-service: upstream timeout calling fraud-api after 2000ms (sample timestamps=2026-09-23T11:39:47+00:00 to 2026-09-23T12:17:47+00:00)

likely_causes.title: Fraud-check service unavailable
likely_causes.rationale: The fraud-check service was unavailable, causing PaymentAuthorizationException errors in payment-service, which contributed to increased latency and error rates.

supporting_evidence.detail: ERROR payment-service: PaymentAuthorizationException: fraud check unavailable (sample timestamps=2026-09-23T11:19:47+00:00 to 2026-09-23T12:13:47+00:00)

next_steps: Verify the health and metrics of fraud-api during the incident window
Check network connectivity and latency between payment-service and fraud-api
Review any recent deployments or configuration changes to fraud-api or payment-service
Implement or adjust retry/backoff logic for fraud-api calls
Monitor payment-service latency and error rates after remediation
